subject: NovaPay outage: incident-time log retention & handoff play
messages:
From: ops@novapay.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: cto@novapay.com
Date: 2027-06-15T09:12:00Z
Subject: High error rate and latency spike — immediate help needed

Marissa,

We experienced a major latency surge and a jump in 5xx error rate starting ~08:55 UTC that is affecting our payment flows. Error rate peaked at 7.2% and average p95 latency doubled. Our engineers see a pattern of timeouts when calling Redwood's /generate endpoint. Can you confirm you're aware and tell us what artifacts you can produce for immediate triage (logs, traces, tokenization details)?

We need evidence for our SRE and legal team — retention of raw request/response logs could be required for an audit if this turns into a regulatory event. Please advise on preservation steps and who on your side I should coordinate with.

-Maria Gomez
Ops Lead, NovaPay

Attachments: novapay_error_sample.png (screenshot of error spikes)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: ops@novapay.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-15T09:28:00Z
Subject: Re: High error rate and latency spike — immediate help needed

Maria — thanks for the heads up and the screenshot. We're taking this seriously. I've looped in Rishi (compliance/legal) and Sean (runtime ops). Immediate plan:

- Sean will snapshot and preserve the runtime logs (request/response headers, anonymized tokens where required) and the last 72h of aggregated runtime metrics.
- Rishi will advise on retention/hold scope for any PII/PIA concerns and whether we need to escalate to Legal formally.
- I'll coordinate delivery of artifacts and a short exec note you can share with stakeholders.

Please keep a timeline of when you first observed degraded calls and any request IDs you have (e.g., req-1432) — that will speed up correlation.

I'll follow up within 30 minutes with what we can produce immediately.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ops@novapay.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-15T09:40:00Z
Subject: Re: High error rate and latency spike — immediate help needed

Maria / team — I'm on it. Quick notes from the runtime team: we see a correlated burst on the dedicated pool servicing NovaPay between 08:54:20 and 09:06:10 UTC. Immediate artifacts we can produce now:

1) Aggregated per-minute metrics (p50/p95/p99 latency, error counts) — exporting to runtime-aggregates-20270615.csv (attached).
2) Traces for three representative requests around the spike — minimal PII in traces; sensitive fields redacted. We have a trace snippet for req-1432 (trace attached as trace-req-1432-snippet.txt).
3) Full request headers and response status for requests that match the customer request IDs — note these contain customer-provided prompt content.

Preservation action already taken: cold snapshot of raw logs and KV caches made at 09:18 UTC to prevent log rotation from removing evidence. We will not purge these until Legal signs off.

I need confirmation from Rishi on whether we should provide full raw payloads (they include customer prompt text) or only metadata and anonymized payloads. If NovaPay requests raw prompts in writing, we can produce under NDAs/DSAR flow.

Sean Gallagher
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: runtime-aggregates-20270615.csv, trace-req-1432-snippet.txt
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, ops@novapay.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-15T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: High error rate and latency spike — immediate help needed

Thanks team — a few legal/compliance asks so we stay aligned:

1) Hold scope: preserve all raw logs and traces for a 30-day legal hold scoped to NovaPay-related requests (match by client_id and the time window 08:45–09:15 UTC). Do not delete or rotate these until I confirm release.
2) PII handling: redact any fields that contain end-user PII before sending outputs externally. If NovaPay explicitly requests raw prompts (they own the prompts), they must send a written request signed by an authorized contact (CTO or legal), and we will process under the standard data access workflow.
3) Chain-of-custody: generate a simple evidence manifest listing artifacts preserved (filenames, checksums, timestamps) and who accessed them. Laura, please create the manifest and store it in the Novapay evidence drive link.
4) Audit note for execs: Marissa, draft a 1–2 paragraph exec summary with impact (users affected, duration, p95 delta) and the retention/hold status for sharing with the customer execs and internal leadership.

I'll stand by to approve any external delivery.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Legal & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, ops@novapay.com
Date: 2027-06-15T15:48:00Z
Subject: Re: High error rate and latency spike — immediate help needed

All — quick update and artifacts delivered to the evidence folder. Actions completed:

- Evidence manifest created: Novapay_INC-4479_manifest.txt (checksum list and preservation timestamps).
- runtime-aggregates-20270615.csv uploaded to Drive.
- trace snippets redacted for PII and uploaded as trace-req-1432-snippet.txt.
- Raw log snapshot placed in secure cold storage; access restricted.

Marissa — I left a short exec summary in the Drive (exec_summary_novapay_INC-4479.md). Maria/CTO: you should have access; if you need the unredacted prompts, please send a signed written request to legal@redwood.ai.

Laura Bennett
Compliance Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Novapay_INC-4479_manifest.txt (manifest), exec_summary_novapay_INC-4479.md
